name: coupon
title: Coupon
description: Coupons people actually want to tap — a vivid value panel (sunburst, confetti, waves…) joined to a details panel by a perforated tear line with real cut-outs. Ten themes, five outlines (ticket, stamp, receipt, scallop, cut-out), copyable code, Apply button, live countdown, applied / used / expired / locked states, a light sweep, and an optional 3D tilt with a holo sheen that flips over to the T&C.
props: What the offer is and its conditions.
Promo code in a dashed chip — tap to copy when onCopy is set.
Live countdown ("Ends in 05:42:10"); turns expired when it passes.
Shown on the back — the T&C link turns the coupon over.
Applied shows a green ring; used / expired dim with a stamp; locked goes grey.
Why it's locked ("Add ₹120 more to unlock").

A light sweep across the value panel every few seconds.
